title: Projects with STAR
intro: Tell project stories with STAR: the Situation, your Task, the Action you took, and the Result with a number.
introNative: Project கதையை STAR முறையில் சொல்லுங்கள்: Situation, உங்கள் Task, நீங்கள் எடுத்த Action, எண்ணுடன் Result.

phrases.text: The challenge was that our loan approval API was taking eight seconds to respond.
phrases.native: எங்கள் loan approval API பதில் தர எட்டு வினாடிகள் எடுத்தது; அதுதான் சவால்.
phrases.note: Start with the problem so the story has a clear reason.

phrases.text: My task was to bring the response time under two seconds.
phrases.native: Response time-ஐ இரண்டு வினாடிகளுக்குக் கீழ் கொண்டுவருவதுதான் என் task.
phrases.note: Make your own task clear, separate from the team's goal.

phrases.text: I led the investigation and found three slow database queries.
phrases.native: நான் investigation-ஐ முன்னின்று நடத்தி, மெதுவாக ஓடிய மூன்று database queries-ஐக் கண்டுபிடித்தேன்.
phrases.note: Use "I" for your own actions; "we" can hide your contribution.

phrases.text: We added Redis caching and rewrote the queries with proper indexes.
phrases.native: Redis caching சேர்த்து, சரியான indexes-உடன் queries-ஐ மாற்றி எழுதினோம்.
phrases.note: Use the simple past for actions in a finished story.

phrases.text: As a result, response time dropped by 75%, to under two seconds.
phrases.native: இதன் விளைவாக, response time 75% குறைந்து இரண்டு வினாடிகளுக்குக் கீழ் வந்தது.
phrases.note: Always end with a result, ideally with a number.

steps.prompt: The interviewer asks: "Tell me about a challenging project." How do you start? Which answer is best?
steps.promptNative: Interviewer "ஒரு challenging project பற்றிச் சொல்லுங்கள்" என்கிறார். எப்படித் தொடங்குவீர்கள்? எந்த பதில் சிறந்தது?
options: It was a very challenging project, we all worked very hard.
Actually, so many challenges were there in that project.
The challenge was that our loan approval API was taking eight seconds to respond.
steps.answer: The challenge was that our loan approval API was taking eight seconds to respond.
steps.explanation: Name one specific problem with a detail; general words like "very challenging" say nothing.
steps.explanationNative: ஒரு குறிப்பிட்ட பிரச்சனையை விவரத்துடன் சொல்லுங்கள். "Very challenging" என்பது எதையும் விளக்காது.

steps.promptNative: Response time-ஐ இரண்டு வினாடிகளுக்குக் கீழ் கொண்டுவருவதுதான் என் task.
steps.answer: My task was to bring the response time under two seconds.

steps.audioText: I led the investigation and found three slow database queries.
options: I led the integration and found three slow database queries.
I led the investigation and found three slow database queries.
I let the investigation run and found two slow database queries.
steps.answer: I led the investigation and found three slow database queries.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: Me and my team reduced the response time by 75 percentage.
options: Me and my team reduced the response time by 75 percentage.
My team and I reduced the response time by 75 percent.
Me and my team reduced the response time by 75 percent.
My team and me reduced the response time by 75 percentage.
steps.answer: My team and I reduced the response time by 75 percent.
steps.explanation: As the subject, say "my team and I"; and say "75 percent", not "75 percentage".
steps.explanationNative: வாக்கியத்தின் subject-ஆக "my team and I" என்று சொல்லுங்கள். "75 percentage" அல்ல, "75 percent".

steps.prompt: You've explained what you did. The interviewer is waiting for the ending. Which answer is best?
steps.promptNative: நீங்கள் செய்ததை விளக்கிவிட்டீர்கள். Interviewer முடிவுக்காகக் காத்திருக்கிறார். எந்த பதில் சிறந்தது?
options: After that, the client was happy only.
As a result, response time dropped by 75%, to under two seconds.
So like that we completed the project.
steps.answer: As a result, response time dropped by 75%, to under two seconds.
steps.explanation: End with a measurable result; it proves your action worked.
steps.explanationNative: அளவிடக்கூடிய result-உடன் முடியுங்கள். உங்கள் action வேலை செய்தது என்பதற்கு அதுவே சான்று.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: I did the full development of that module only.
options: I did the full development of that module only.
I developed that whole module on my own.
I only did the full development of that module only.
Only I did the full development of that module.
steps.answer: I developed that whole module on my own.
steps.explanation: Don't add "only" at the end for emphasis; say "on my own" to show you did it alone.
steps.explanationNative: அழுத்தத்துக்காக வாக்கியத்தின் கடைசியில் "only" சேர்க்க வேண்டாம். தனியாகச் செய்ததைச் சொல்ல "on my own" என்று சொல்லுங்கள்.

steps.promptNative: Redis caching சேர்த்து, சரியான indexes-உடன் queries-ஐ மாற்றி எழுதினோம்.
steps.answer: We added Redis caching and rewrote the queries with proper indexes.

steps.audioText: As a result, response time dropped by 75%, to under two seconds.
options: As a result, response time dropped by 75%, to under two seconds.
As a result, response time dropped by 25%, to under two seconds.
As a result, response time went up by 75%, to over two seconds.
steps.answer: As a result, response time dropped by 75%, to under two seconds.

steps.prompt: Tell a real project story from your work out loud using STAR, in 4–5 sentences: the challenge, your task, what you did, and the result with a number.
steps.promptNative: உங்கள் வேலையில் நடந்த ஒரு உண்மையான project கதையை STAR முறையில் 4–5 வாக்கியங்களில் சத்தமாகச் சொல்லுங்கள்: சவால், உங்கள் task, நீங்கள் செய்தது, எண்ணுடன் result.
